# repaircafe.amsterdam source guide

## Luna quick start · checked 18 October 2026

- Open the official [Agenda](https://repaircafe.amsterdam/en) and use its date headings and venue rows for the exact occurrence date and start/end time.
- Open the named venue card only for its street address and repair scope. The checked card's “Next time” field was stale, so keep the date from the live Agenda row.
- Check [About Repair Cafés](https://repaircafe.amsterdam/en/repaircafes) for entry and cost rules: admission and repair help are free, contributions are optional, and parts or refreshments may cost extra.
- Copy event title, exact agenda date/time, district, venue address, stated repair scope, cost and walk-in/registration terms. Mark unstated fields unknown.
- Stop if the Agenda has no dated row in `{start_date}`–`{end_date}` or only recurring venue hours; do not generate occurrences from the pattern.

Copyable prompt: `Check https://repaircafe.amsterdam/en for individually dated Repair Café rows from {start_date} to {end_date}. Copy title, date/time, district, and venue. Open the venue card only for address and repair scope, and check https://repaircafe.amsterdam/en/repaircafes for cost and walk-in terms. Prefer the Agenda date over any stale “Next time” field. Stop if no dated agenda row is visible; do not expand recurring hours.`

Saved evidence checked through 2026-10-18.

## Evidence and route limits

Historical route unspecified in saved evidence. The URLs above are saved entry pages, not a verified navigation recipe.
Exact agenda navigation and selectors remain unverified unless a saved source observation states them.

## Recheck rules

- Use public, actual date-selectable pages for dated records. A recurring weekly schedule or opening hours is not an occurrence; never expand recurrence.
- Verify that a single visit is allowed for one person, the exact regular single-person price, and any eligibility conditions, class-booking requirements, rentals, or other extras. A gym day pass does not imply group-class admission.
- Keep unknown prices, class inclusion, audience rules, language, dates, and availability unknown. Keep women-only, intro-only, member-only, or other conditions explicit.
- Do not create accounts, book, pay, contact organizers, enter gated flows, or bypass access controls.
- Apply the current profile settings when selecting offerings.
